item.title: Focuset 0.11.3
item.description:
Focuset 0.11.3 makes adding windows and switching between them easier.

  • ⌃⌥ click adds or removes any window**, also while you are focused on one window. Hold ⌃⌥ and the window under the pointer lights up green (click to add) or red (click to remove).
  • Pairs come back.** With Follow click, clicking outside a pair or set focuses that window; clicking any window of the pair again brings the whole pair back.
  • Fixed:** installing a new version over a running Focuset (Homebrew, the install script or a manual copy) could leave the old copy running next to the new one, and Focuset stopped working. The new copy now closes the old one.

item.title: Focuset 0.11.2
item.description:
Focuset 0.11.2 makes the menu bar controls respond right away.

  • Follow click starts at once.** Turning it on in the menu bar now focuses the window you were in, instead of waiting for your next click.
  • Blur, Dimming and Grain sliders** are always in the menu bar, also before you start focusing.
  • A short hint explains that the effect switches apply while focusing.

item.title: Focuset 0.11.1
item.description:
Focuset 0.11.1 fixes automatic updates.

  • Fixed:** 0.11.0 could not reach its update feed. From 0.11.1 on, Focuset finds new versions by itself again.

item.title: Focuset 0.11.0
item.description:
Focuset 0.11.0 is the first public release.

  • Updates by themselves.** Focuset checks once a day and asks before installing a new version.
  • Focus follows click.** The window you click stays sharp and everything else softens. Turn it on in the menu bar under Quick toggles.
  • Quiet and Spotlight.** Quiet blurs everything around your window. Spotlight keeps a soft light around it and fades the rest.
  • Quick toggles** in the menu bar: Follow click, Hide Dock, Center window, Grayscale, Grain and Glow.
  • Always sharp apps.** Color pickers, launchers or music players never blur and never interrupt your focus.
  • Appear effects:** Instant, Fade, Bloom and Ripple.
  • Grain strength** from 0 to 100 %.
  • Displays:** keep one window sharp across all displays, or the last clicked window on each display.
  • Fixed: the Dock no longer jerks in and out with auto-hide, and Mission Control is no longer closed by Focuset.
